reason: A vision utility that accepts local image paths or remote image URLs, delegates recognition to a configurable OpenAI-compatible vision model, and returns Chinese text descriptions.

summaries.zh: 为文本模型提供图像识别工具，支持读取本地图片或网络图片并通过可配置的视觉大模型返回文字描述。
summaries.en: Provides image recognition for text-only models by sending local images or remote image URLs to a configurable vision model and returning text descriptions.

capabilities: Accepts local image paths and remote HTTP(S) image URLs
Sends image inputs to a configurable OpenAI-compatible vision API
Uses configurable API credentials, model, and base URL
